citation: H. A. Ogden, [Uniforms] Infantry, Artillery, 1802-1810, Pl. XI, lithograph, 1888 (published by G. H. Boek; copyright Gen. S. B. Holabird). Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division, item 2021654575.
author: Henry Alexander Ogden
repository: Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division, item 2021654575 (reproduction cph 3a06516).
locator: The plate, two infantrymen in the foreground.
rights_note: Published in the United States in 1888; public domain by date (the Library records "rights status not evaluated"). Used only as a reference picture for the older pattern a frontier post may still have worn (T-3451); nothing is traced or sampled from it.
access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (T-3451) in the Library's 488 x 640 reference image (black and white). A late-nineteenth-century reconstruction, not a period picture: infantrymen of 1802-1810 in long-skirted dark coats with facings, white crossbelts, white waistcoats, round hats crested with bearskin and a feather, gaiters.
note: One of the 1812 soldier reference set's pictures (data/people_match/reference_sets/soldier_1812.json); an 1888 reconstruction, graded as later scholarship.
what_it_supplies: an 1888 reconstruction of the infantry pattern before 1810, which a frontier company may still have worn in 1812
what_it_does_not_supply: period evidence: it was drawn some eighty years later
colour (the reference image is black and white)
